description: One agent tool call as a card: the status mark, a title, the tool's name and the time it took, with the input and the output (or the error) in a body that opens. A failed call opens on its own. Agents read the name, status and summaries of the input and output, and open the card through its collapsible.
moves: The card rises in when it arrives (flourish).
A running call's mark turns and its title has a light passing through it; both say "working" and run at any flourish.
When the call finishes, the tick pops in and draws itself (flourish); a failed or denied mark pops in.
A new status label fades in; it rises into place with flourish.
The body opens to its real height and the chevron turns.
Input and output rise in one after the other as the body opens (flourish).

propDocs.ToolCall.name: The tool's name, like "search_orders". Shown in a small mono chip.
propDocs.ToolCall.title: A short human title, like "Looked up order #1048". It names the card for screen readers and agents.
propDocs.ToolCall.input: The call's arguments. Any value: objects show as pretty JSON in a code block.
propDocs.ToolCall.output: What the tool returned. Any value.
propDocs.ToolCall.error: Why it failed, shown in place of the output when status is "error".
propDocs.ToolCall.duration: How long it took, in milliseconds: 420ms, 2.4s, 1m 12s.
propDocs.ToolCall.startedAt: When a running call started (epoch ms); the card counts up from it.
propDocs.ToolCall.open: Whether the body is open. Use with onOpenChange to control it.
propDocs.ToolCall.defaultOpen: Whether the body starts open. A failed call starts open.
propDocs.ToolCall.onOpenChange: Runs when the body opens or closes; details.reason is "status-error" when a failure opened it, and details.source is "agent" when an agent did.
propDocs.ToolCall.openOnError: Open the body on its own when the call fails. On by default.
propDocs.ToolCall.children: Parts to lay the card out yourself (ToolCallTrigger, ToolCallIcon, ToolCallTitle, ToolCallName, ToolCallStatusText, ToolCallDuration, ToolCallContent, ToolCallSection, ToolCallLabel, ToolCallValue). Without children the card is built from its props.

cssVars: Tallest input or output before it scrolls
